title: Strange Hospital
content: So I was walking in the hallways of a high school campus when suddenly it morphed into a hospital corridor. I entered a room and for some reason, I saw a team of medical staff performing a life-saving surgery on a goldfish the size of a fully grown farm pig. The goldfish was struggling to breathe while the medical team was removing gunk from the goldfish's cardiovascular system. In the process, that goldfish gunk landed on me, so I decided to wash myself in a nearby sink. For some reason, there was a nurse who started to scrape my head and I yelled at her to quit it. The dream immediately ended when I yelled. Have you guys experienced looking at weird animals that look like chimeras? Weeks ago, I was looking at "parasites" from the future and it was mostly cockroaches with ugly-looking straws on its back.
